content: Removing a stale queue entry requires written operator approval before the deletion runs.
The operator approval and the completed deletion were audited in September.
An operator approved the removal of the stale queue entry on 2026-09-20, and the deletion completed that day.
The September 2026 audit report found that the queue deletion procedure did not require written operator approval before a removal.
In response to the audit finding, the queue team added a written operator approval step to the deletion procedure, effective October 2026.
Queue retention is 30 days in the European region; entries older than that are archived rather than deleted.
The 30 day queue retention window does not apply to audit entries, which are retained for 400 days.
Queue retention is 45 days in the North American region; entries older than that are archived rather than deleted.

Replacing the cracked tiles requires scaffolding, and the repair is recommended before the rainy season.
